answer_1.quote: Our contributions can be summarized as: • We introduce Tree-of-Debate, a structured multi-persona debate framework, to generate fine-grained contrastive summaries.

answer_4.quote: The same domain-experts from Section 4.1 manually evaluate each sample in-depth, assessing various qualities of the 100 summaries.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators scored summaries based on factuality (binary per sentence), completeness (Likert scale 0-4), and contextualization (Likert scale 0-4), with detailed guidelines in Appendix C.
